# 九条命

![9 条生命指示器](https://github.com/bleudev/nine_lifes/raw/master/markdown_assets/9lifes_indicator.png)

[![下载量](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/nine_lifes)](https://modrinth.com/mod/nine_lifes)
[![最新版本](https://img.shields.io/badge/Latest_version-5.2-orange)](https://modrinth.com/mod/nine_lifes/versions)
[![支持的 Minecraft 版本](https://img.shields.io/badge/Supported_Minecraft_Versions-26.1.2--26.3--snapshot--2-green)](https://modrinth.com/mod/nine_lifes)
[![运行环境](https://img.shields.io/badge/Environment-Client%2BServer-blue)](https://modrinth.com/mod/nine_lifes)
[![GitHub 贡献者](https://img.shields.io/github/contributors/bleudev/nine_lifes)](https://github.com/bleudev/nine_lifes/graphs/contributors)
[![GitHub 提交活跃度](https://img.shields.io/github/commit-activity/w/bleudev/nine_lifes)](https://github.com/bleudev/nine_lifes/activity)
[![GitHub 最近一次提交](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/bleudev/nine_lifes)](https://github.com/bleudev/nine_lifes/activity)

Nine lifes 是一款模组，它会让你的整个生存模式中仅有 9 条命。对于那些厌倦了原版极限模式的玩家来说，这是一个非常酷炫的挑战。如需修改生命数量，请使用 `/nl` 命令。祝游玩愉快！

![仅支持 Fabric](https://wsrv.nl/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fi.ibb.co%2FyphNcXz%2Ffabric-only-banner.png&n=-1)
